description: SSEN Transmission Eastern Green Link 2 - Linear Route (Preliminary) is a dataset listed in SSEN Transmission Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SSEN Transmission is a trading name of Scottish Hydro Electric Transmission plc, company number SC213461. This dataset contains data on the subsea cable locations for the Eastern Green Link 2 (EGL2) route. Please note: These are design routes and are therefore subject to potential change. More information about the project can be found here To view or download this data, please register or login. Coverage: north of Scotland (SSEN Transmission network area). The portal files it under Infrastructure. Its keywords are EGL2, Marine, Cable, Route, Location, Subsea. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-ssentransmission-portal.
